title: Great Fairy Mija
description: Unlocking the Great Fairies involves a series of Side Adventures. Ultimately, you will need to reunite all the members of [The Stable Trotters](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279499) and have them lure the Great Fairies out of their flower Buds with beautiful music. Here is the Side Adventure sequence you must complete to unlock Mija: - [Potential Princess Sightings](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277846) - [Serenade to a Great Fairy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279983) - [The Hornist's Dramatic Escape](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280076) - [Serenade to Mija](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280073)

title: Nachoyah Shrine
description: _The Ability to Rewind_ Location: 0388, -1660, 2299 - Inside the [Room of Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276620). After completing [The Closed Door](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279111) and receiving the Rewind ability, come back here and ride the Rewinded cogs to the shrine. Solution: 1. Rewind the wooden raft, then jump on it to the other platform. 2. Rewind the wooden raft, then jump on it to move up the waterfall. 3. In the next room, turn right. Wait until both hands are aligned, then Rewind one of them. Walk through the door to the end statue. Treasure: - 10x Arrow - On a platform, above the water next to the cog. Rewind the cog to access.

title: Gutanbac Shrine
description: _The Ability to Rise_ Location: 0709, -1381, 1584 - ?? Solution: 1. Ascend from the ground to the higher platform. 2. Ascend through the right-most pillar. 3. Defeat the Construct Guardian. 4. Cut the ropes of the bridge, which will fall down, then Ascend through it to reach the end statue. Treasure: - [Stone Axe [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279250) - In the 2nd room, ascend through the left-most pillar first. - [Construct Bow [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279251) - In the construct room, destroy the wooden boxes in the right wall to reveal an alcove; Ascend in the alcove to the chest.

title: Ukouh Shrine
description: _The Ability to Create_ Location: 0274, -0913, 1460 - ?? Solution: 1. Move the stone slab to create a bridge and cross the first gap. 2. Using Ultrahand, glue both slabs together to create an even longer bridge, and cross the second gap. 3. Ultrahand a Hook on a Board, to create a platform, and place it on the rail. Jump on it and ride it to the end. Treasure: - Amber - Beyond the second gap, use the long bridge to reach a higher platform in the corner.

title: In-isa Shrine
description: _The Ability to Combine_ Location: 0027, -1503, 1408 - ?? Solution: 1. Fuse the Boulder to any weapon (such as the nearby Broadsword) to create a Hammer. Use this hammer to smash the cracked pillars on the far side of the room. 2. In the next room, turn right and collect the Fire Fruits from the bushes. 3. Fire a Flaming Arrow at the vine-covered platform against the far wall. You can make an arrow flaming by Fusing a Fire Fruit to it. 4. Grab the Small Key from the fallen chest, and unlock the door to the end statue. Treasure: - 5x Arrow - On a pillar, in the second room. Break it using a makeshift hammer to drop the chest.

title: Yamiyo Shrine
description: _Combat Training: Throwing_ Location: 0334, 0467, 0029 Solution: - Defeat the construct, following the on-screen prompts Treasure: - Bomb Flower x3 - Just before the end statue.

title: Mayachin Shrine
description: Location: -0705, -0865, 0031 - Windvane Meadow, near the Exchange Ruins. Solution: - First step on square pressure pad on floor for the first target to appear. - Attach a pole to the flat side of a stake, then attach stake to backside of the mechanism in middle of lowered area. - Once attached - go to top level and swing at level to make the pole swing like a bat. - Wait for the ball to hit 3rd to 4th notch on ground for correct timing. Treasure: - Energizing Elixir - must hit second target

title: Kamizun Shrine
description: _Proving Grounds: Beginner_ Location: -0177, -1557, 0023 - ?? Solution: 1. Defeat all the constructs, using only the gear provided in the room. Treasure: - [Spring Shield [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280446) - Just before the end statue.

title: Jiosin Shrine
description: _Shape Rotation_ Location: -3983, -1084, 0624 - ?? Solution: 1. Ultrahand the long piece of stone, and rotate it so it fits through the X-shaped hole in the wall. 2. Use the long piece of stone to create a bridge to the other side. 3. Repeat the process for the dual-cube-shaped piece of rock, rotating it so it fits through both walls. 4. Place the shape to create a staircase to the end statue. Treasure: - Hasty Elixir - On a ledge, in the 2nd puzzle room. After crossing the first gate, place the two blocks in the hole to create a staircase to the chest.

title: Zanmik Shrine
description: _Scoop It Out_ Location: 3469, -2179, 0148 - Overlooking [Hateno Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276892), by the eastern gate. Solution: 1. Drop down, then Attach a ball to the wheel. 2. Place a metal plate on the circuit to close it, activating the wheel. 3. Climb back up, and drop the ball in the socket to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Zonaite Longsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279699) - Attach 4 plates in a 2x2 formation, then Attach it to the wheel before activating it. This should scoop the balls out and reveal the chest underneath.

title: Turakamik Shrine
description: _Hidden Metal_ Location: -2654, -2238, 0067 - On a high ledge on the side of the canyon road. Solution: 1. Attach the electrified ball to the other to close the circuit and activate the giant cog. Ride it to the higher ledge. 2. Using Ultrahand, swing one of the balls side-to-side, then Attach the other one to it. Then, Ascend to the alternating pillars. 3. Dislodge the pipe from the cog system, and place it on the beams next to the electrified ball. Attach the ball to it to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Zonaite Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282819) - In the 3rd room, before removing the pole, Recall the cog and ride it to the higher ledge.

title: Mayatat Shrine
description: _A Sliding Device_ Location: -3290, -2512, 0024 - Near the Kara Kara Bazaar Solution: 1. Recall one of the sliding sleds, then jump on it to reach the higher ledge. 2. Attach a Steering Stick and a Fan to the Sled, then pilot it to the end statue. Treasure: - Arrow x10 - In the large room, on a higher platform to the left. Pilot the boat there first, then glide to the lower platform and build another one to reach the end.

title: Soryotanog Shrine
description: _Buried Light_ Location: -3884, -2964, 0123 - At the top of the palace in Gerudo Town Solution: 1. Dislodge the Fan from the sand dune. Activate it, then Ultrahand it to blow away the last sand dune. 2. Pick up the Small Key from the chest and open the door. 3. In the next room, Ascend to the ledge on the left and destroy the construct. 4. Blow away the sand dunes to reveal both a beam of light and a mirror. Place the mirror on the upper ledge to reflect the beam through the gates. Aim at the corner of the walls beyond the bars. 5. Return in the first room, and blow away the mirror from the sand dune. Using Ultrahand, reflect the light beam into the hexagon above the door. Treasure: - 10x Arrows - Beyond the Small Key door, turn right and crouch in the alcove. There, blow away the sand dunes and grab the Fan Guster from the defeated construct. Glide to the upper ledge using your Fan, then attack the sand dune with the Fan Guster to blow it away. The cog should move and open the door to the chest.

title: Ishodag Shrine
description: _A Windy Device_ Location: On top of the rocky mound. Solution: - Rotate the first fan so it is blowing air up, close to the next floor, and use your glider to get to the next floor. - Attach the second fan to the back of the board and activate it to float across the water. - Take the fan off the wooden platform and attach it to the small platform that can be dragged up and down leading to the next floor, facing up and activate it. Leave it for now. - Attach one of the fans to the bottom of the rotating concrete platform to get the chest upright. Use the second fan to blow your glider up to the platform. - Open the chest and use the ultrahand to push the previous platform up as high as you can take it. Let it drop back down. - Get on top of the platform and use Recall so it goes back up. Use your glider with the fan you placed there earlier and that will get you to the shrine's end. Treasure: - Opal - Stuck to a pivoting platform, past the pool. Attach a fan to the platform, just under the chest, and activate it to rotate the platform. Then, Ascend through to open the chest.

title: Jonsau Shrine
description: _Deep Force_ Location: 1751, 0011, 0034 - On a grassy plain, near the shore. Solution: 1. Ultrahand the floating ball underneath the target, then push it down the water and release it. It should launch upwards and hit the target. 2. In the next room, defeat the construct. 3. Repeat step 1 with the floating board, placing it vertically so it launches straight. 4. In the next room, launch the floating ball under the moving platform to dislodge it and let it fall into the water. Then, jump in the platform and Recall it to the top. 5. Paraglide to the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Construct Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283430) - In the 2nd room, in the water by the first pillar. Grab it with Ultrahand.

title: Morok Shrine
description: _A Bouncy Device_ Location: 1178, -0781, 0133 - On a floating island, connected to the ground by a thick root. Climb up the root, or glide from the higher sky islands. Solution: 1. Step on the launch pad to launch Link upwards and glide to the ledge. 2. Step on the Spring, then activate it to launch Link upwards and glide to the ledge. 3. Bring the Spring against the right-most fence, and use it to reach the platform. 4. On that platform, take the Spring and prop it against the slanted slab to create a makeshift launch pad. Use it to send the ball on the main platform and into the socket. 5. Glide back to the main platform, then Attach the Spring to the other 2 in the next room. Place the triple spring against the far wall. 6. Climb the triple spring, then activate it to reach the end statue. Treasure: - Sneaky Elixir - After activating the triple Spring, glide to the platform halfway up the steep wall.

title: Teniten Shrine
description: _Combat Training: Throwing_ Location: -0075, -115, 0021 - Out in the open, just east of the lake. Solution: 1. Defeat the construct, following the on-screen prompts. Treasure: - Zonaite Spear - Just before the end statue.

title: Tukarok Shrine
description: _Forward Force_ Location: 0915, -0250, -0034 - In a grove beside the stable. Solution: 1. Walk to the end of the hallway and drop down. 2. Attach the ball to the vehicule, then activate it to make it cross the lava. 3. Attach the Big Wheel to the slab on the rail, then Attach the rectangular slab to it and the ball on top. When activated, the slab should advance all the way to the top. 4. Bring the ball into the next room, and Attach it to the board with wheels. Then, Attach a board to each Wheel to create paddles. 5. Place the paddleboat between the fences and activate it, then place the ball on the pressure plate to open the door. 6. Place the ball in the socket to reach the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Zonaite Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279459) - Under the water, between the two fences. Grab it with Ultrahand.

title: Eutoum Shrine
description: _Proving Grounds: Infiltration_ Location: -3509, 3568, 0387 - Against the far side of the peak. Solution: 1. Defeat the constructs, using only the gear provided in the room. Treasure: - Sapphire - Just before the end statue.

title: Gatakis Shrine
description: _Ride the Winds_ Location: -3651, 1805, 0168 - Inside Rito Village, jump down from the main path to reach a side ledge. Solution: 1. Gliding with your paraglider, use the gusts to guide Link through the obstacles. Treasure: - [Strong Construct Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280000) - Past the ice barrier, on a high ledge guarded by a construct.

title: Ijo-o Shrine
description: _More than Defense_ Location: -3862, 2679, 0702 - On a lonely sky island. Solution: 1. Defeat the construct, then use his Flame-Emitter Shield to melt the ice block in the doorway. 2. Defeat the construct on the left, then use his Stone-Slab shield to move beyond the flames into the next room. 3. Defeat the construct in the large room. Then, Attach a few Rockets on the stone slab, and use it as a launching platform to the end statue. Treasure: - Arrow x5 - Beyond the doorway, within an ice block. Melt it with the Flame-Emitter Shield.

title: Mayaumekis Shrine
description: _Downward Force_ Location: -2947, 3051, 0897 - Rising Island Chain of the Hebra Sky Solution: 1. Shoot the crystal through the bars to open the door. 2. Defeat the construct atop the ledge, then jump and bounce off the trampoline to the ledge above. 3. Wait for the moving trampoline to move closer, then jump on the trampoline just beneath and glide to it. 4. Wait for it to move closer, then bounce on the next platform. 5. Bounce on the nearby trampoline, and at the peak of the jump, shoot the crystal through the bars. 6. Head to the trampoline ahead, and bounce to the end statue. Treasure: - Arrow x10 - In the corner of the main room, on a high pillar. While on the moving trampoline, bounce once you reach the corner.

title: Runakit Shrine
description: _Built to Carry_ Location: -2527, 1169, 0177 - In the open, west of the tower. Solution: 1. Climb the ladder on the farthest ledge, then place the ball on the rails to slide it to the lower ledge. 2. Attach both poles together, then the ball under it in the center. Place the contraption on the rails, which should slide to the lower ledge. 3. Build the following contraption. Then, place it on the single rail to slide it to the starting platform. - Attach two square stone slabs in an L-shape. - Under each slab, attach a pole so it looks like a roof with 2 columns. - Attach the ball to both pillars. 4. Place the ball in the socket to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - [Construct Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282768) - On a pillar, beyond the 2nd lower ledge. Attach multiple stone slabs end-to-end to make a ramp to the chest.

title: Sahirow Shrine
description: _Aid from Above_ Location: -3354, 2387, 0361 - Near the top of Corvash Peak. Solution: 1. Cross the laser-filled hallway. Jump over the low lasers and crouch under the others. 2. Ascend to the higher platform and turn left. 3. Cross the two hallways, jumping over the 1st laser and crouching under the 2nd. 4. In the final hallway, wait for the structure to be near, then Ascend through the top and glide to the end platform. Treasure: - Spicy Elixir - On the higher platform, crouch under the laser. Then, Ultrahand the block in front of the laser to open the gate to the chest.

title: Sinakawak Shrine
description: _An Uplifting Device_ Location: -1372, 0749, 0086 - Just behind [New Serenne Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276878). Solution: 1. Create a makeshift Hot-air Platform; you can do so by attaching a Candle to the center of a Board, then attacking a Balloon on top of the candle. 2. Use the hot-air platform to reach the higher ledge; if the platform flies away, you can Rewind it to the ground. 3. Dislodge the Board from the hot-air platform, and place the Candle-Balloon in front of the gate. It should rise and open the gate. 4. Paraglide to the bottom floor, and make another Hot-air Platform, this time attaching the small ball to it. 5. Ascend to the higher ledge, then Dislodge the ball into the small socket, opening the gate to the end statue. Treasure: - Opal - In the final room, make the following contraption. Attach the Large Ball to the Board, then 2 Candles on opposite corners. Finally, attach a Balloon to each candle; the contraption should slowly ascend. Dislodge it from the higher ledge and into the large socket.

title: Tajikats Shrine
description: _Building With Logs_ Location: Along the river, in plain sight. Solution: - Use Ultrahand to maneuver the log into a ramp to get up the first hurdle. Make sure to prop up the log on a corner so it doesn't roll away! - In the next area, you will be give 2 more logs. Grab the log from the previous step, and create a tripod-looking shape with all three. The angle-fused legs should be able to lean on the ledge of the ramp, allowing you to cross without it slipping away. - Fuse the 2 new logs into a bridge to cross the small water obstacle. - You are given 4 additional logs. Using all 4, plus the 2 from the previous water obstacle, you need to create a bridge that is 3-logs long and 2-logs thick; the double wide bridge will prevent rolling. - In the final area, you are given 9 logs and 2 propellers. You can either use the propellers to create a boat, or use the all the logs (plus the logs from the previous step) to create a massive bridge to the shrine's end. Or, if you have enough stamina, you can swim across.) Treasure: - Spiky Shield: In the final area, there is a small platform on the left side of the water.

title: Tauyosipun Shrine
description: _Forward or Backward?_ Location: -4535, 2878, 0262 - On the western side of the mountain. Solution: 1. Recall one of the large balls, and run behind it as it rolls up the ramp. 2. Step on the pressure plate to block the ramp, and wait for a ball to fall into it. 3. Ultrahand the large ball and place it on the ramp. 4. Recall the first ball. pushing the 2nd one into the socket and opening the door. 5. Wait for the ball to fall on the 2nd platform, then Recall it. 6. When the ball is in mid-air, just between the two platforms, stop the Recall. It should fall into the socket and open the gate to the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Construct Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282415) - Beyond the first ramp, Recall the wheel just as the chest falls onto it. It should rotate towards Link.

title: Kyononis Shrine
description: _Combat Training_ Location: -0205, 0451, 0021 - ?? Solution: 1. Defeat the construct, following the on-screen prompts. Treasure: - [Zonaite Sword [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279255) - Just before the end statue.

title: Susuyai Shrine
description: _A Spinning Device_ Location: -0785, -0434, 0018 - ?? Solution: 1. Ultrahand the moving carts away to safely cross to the other side. Make sure to bring a cart to the far side. 2. Position the cart forward, then activate it to cross the moving platform. 3. Using Ultrahand, dislodge a Wheel from the cart and attack it to the side of the crank. Activate the Wheel to rotate the crank and open the gate. 4. Remove the platform from the rail, and attach a Wheel in the opening above. 5. Replace the platform on the rail, and activate the Wheel to move the platform to the end statue. Treasure: - 5x Arrows - Attached to the middle cart, at the beginning of the puzzle.

title: Sonapan Shrine
description: _Missing Pathways_ Location: -1921, -0361, 0228 - On the side of Satori Mountain, in an apple grove. Solution: 1. Ascend through the ledge. 2. Place the metal cube on top of the ledge, then Ascend through it to the staircase. 3. Ultrahand the metal cube form the alcove to the pool, just underneath the ledge. 4. Ascend through the alcove on the ledge. Then, paraglide to the metal cube and Ascend to the end statue. Treasure: - Arrow x5 - Embedded high in a wall. After ascending the first ledge, bring the metal cube from the right alcove to the left, creating a pathway to the chest.

title: Ihen-a Shrine
description: _Midair Perch_ Location: 3805 - 0573 - 0484 - At the top of the mountain, by [Miphia Court](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277431) Solution: 1. Ultrahand the platforms to create stairs to the ledge above. 2. Attach the grate to the platform. Then, activate it and place it above the gap; it should remain there and allow you to cross. 3. Bring the grate above the next gate, angling it upwards to access the higher ledge. 4. Attach the ball to a platform, and place it beside the metal slab. 5. Jump on the platform and shoot the crystal; this should launch the platform across the gap. 6. Place the ball in the socket to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - 5x Arrow - In the final room, in an alcove against the left wall. Place a floating platform beside it, then Ascend through.

title: Rasitakiwak Shrine
description: _Proving Grounds: Vehicles_ Location: 4166, 1323, 0229 - Off the road near Tarrey Town. Solution: 1. Defeat all the constructs, using only the gear provided in the room. Treasure: - [Magic Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281646) - Just before the end statue.

title: Mogawak Shrine
description: _The Power of Water_ Location: 3302, 0423, 0112 - Under the walkways of [Zora's Domain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276828) Solution: 1. Grab the empty Battery and place it at the end of the circuit, on the right. 2. Attach the stone plate on the wheel, opposite of the other. Then, move it slightly to get it moving and recharge the Battery. 3. Jump in the moving platform, then place the Battery in the socket to power it upwards to the end statue. Treasure: - Opal - After recharging the battery, bring it close to the left-side pool. Cross the water, then Ultrahand the battery on the plate to complete the circuit and open the door to the chest. - Magic Scepter - Use Ultrahand to lift the chest out of the water next to the waterfall.

title: Orochium Shrine
description: _Courage to Fall_ Location: -1636, 2641, 0239 - In plain sight, north of the [Snowfield Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277694) Solution: 1. Head left of the staircase, and destroy the construct. 2. Ascend to the higher platform, then turn right and fall down. Destroy the 2nd construct. 3. Open the door atop the staircase with Ultrahand. 4. Walk into the lasers to fall down. Walk to the end, then Ascend to the chest with the Small Key and Ascend again. 5. Defeat both constructs and open the door to grab the ball. 6. Ride the elevator up and drop the ball in the socket to open the hangar. 7. Attach the ball to the glider and ride it back to the starting room. 8. Drop the ball in the socket to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - 5x Arrows - After the 2nd construct, instead of climbing the staircase, continue forward. The chest is in an alcove, guarded by a construct.

title: Kiuyoyou Shrine
description: _Fire and Ice_ Location: -1105, 2086, 0104 - In the open by some trees Solution: 1. Grab the ice cube, and melt it so it fits in the alcove with the pressure plate. Place it there to open the door. 2. Glide to the other side with the air flow. 3. Ultrahand the metal plate to block the flames. Then, grab the ice cube out and Attach the metal plate on top of it. Place the cube on the spikes and let it slide back to the start. 4. Place the cube underneath the flames in the starting room to activate the pressure plate and open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - [Zonaite Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282505) - In the 2nd room. Ultrahand the smaller ice cube and place it on the higher ledge. Reach the ledge using the metal plate and climb to the chest.

title: Mayausiy Shrine
description: _Building Blocks_ Location: -1165, 2602, -0083 - Forgotten Temple, beside the toppled statue. Solution: 1. In both rooms, Ultrahand the blocks to match the left-most structure. See the video for detailed instructions. Treasure: - Large Zonai Charge - In the 2nd room, on a pillar in the corner. Before completing the structure, make a climbable structure to reach it.

title: Sikukuu Shrine
description: _Spinning Gears_ Location: 0699, 2793, 0226 - In plain sight from [Thyphlo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277406). Solution: 1. When the ball falls, Rewind the gear so the ball falls near the socket. Place it inside to open the gate. 2. Rotate the lever clockwise, then Rewind it, using the giant cog to access the end statue. Treasure: - [Zonaite Longsword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281654) - After the first gate, rotate the lever counterclockwise instead. When Rewinded, the gear should push you down into a secret room with the chest.

title: Nouda Shrine
description: _Proving Grounds: Intermediate_ Location: -2318, 2202, 0173 - [Kopeeki Drifts Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280387) - Beyond the freezing lake. Let the Ice Like freeze the pond underneath it, then Ultrahand the blocks back to the lake to create platforms. Alternatively, use Ice Fruits. Solution: 1. Defeat the constructs, using only the gear provided in the room. Treasure: - Hearty Elixir - Just before the end statue.

title: Oromuwak Shrine
description: _A Launching Device_ Location: -3079, 1617, 0243 - On top of the mountain ridge, surrounded by spikes. Solution: 1. Place a Rocket in the groove, then activate it. It should launch itself into the target and open the door. 2. Attach a Rocket to the minecart. Then, jump in it and activate it to reach the higher ledge. 3. Repeat step 2, placing the minecart on the slope. This should propel the cart to the end statue. Treasure: - Ruby - In the 3rd room, on a high platform. Attach a Rocket to a minecart, pointing upwards, and activate it.

title: Taki-Ihaban Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: -1830, 1193, 0147 - [Lindor's Brow Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277702), on a high ledge beyond the Gloom Hands. Solution: 1. Walk up to the end statue. Treasure: - Large Zonai Charge - Just before the end statue.

title: Oshozan-u Shrine
description: _Mallet Smash_ Location: -1404, 3677, 0288 - On top of an icy pinnacle. Solution: 1. Attach the long stone mallet to the sliding platform. Then, Attach the rocket to the mallet, and activate it to launch it into the target. 2. Repeat step 1 in the next room to open the gate to the end statue. Treasure: - [Zonaite Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282418) - In the 2nd room, on a high ledge. Place a cylinder in the alcove, then climb it to the chest.

title: Kahatanaum Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: -3296, 3431, 1347 - East Hebra Sky Archipelago Solution: 1. Walk up to the end statue. Treasure: - Large Zonai Charge - Just before the end statue.

title: Marakuguc Shrine
description: _Wheeled Wonders_ Location: 1761, 2508, 0473 - Above Goron City Solution: 1. Attach the end of the bridge to the poles to cross the gap. 2. Attach the wheeled platform to the end of the bridge, then activate the wheels. The platform should roll past the gap and extend the bridge. 3. Attach both wheeled platforms together, then jump on them and activate the wheels to cross the large gap. 4. Ascend to the higher platform and defeat the construct. 5. Attach the grate to the front of the vehicule and activate it. This should push most balls on the pressure plate and open the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Construct Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281652) - On top of a pillar, in the corner of the final room. Use the grate as a ramp to climb on top of it.

title: Kikakin Shrine
description: _Shining in Darkness_ Location: -0395, 2735, 0287 - On the mountain ridge Solution: 1. Form the starting room, turn left, then right. Cross the crushing walls, then head at the end of the hallway. 2. Ultrahand the slab away to reveal the chest containing the Small Key, 3. Make your back to the starting the room and unlock the door to the end statue. Treasure: - Opal - In a small alcove. From the starting room, turn left twice; the alcove is just beyond the lasers. - Amber - Behind a stone cube on the wall. From the starting room, turn right, the look on the right wall. - Luminous Stone - Beyond some crushing walls. From the Small Key chest, turn left twice. - Zonaite Bow - Above the ceiling. From the Small Key chest, past the crushing walls, look up for bright hole.

title: Kurakat Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: 2366, -0514, 0156 - On a lone pillar, beside a tree. Shrine Quest: [Dyeing to Find It](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283429) Treasure: - [Magic Scepter](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283428) - Just before the end statue.

title: Jogou Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: 3346, -1184, 0057 - [Lanayru Road East](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281188). In the circular area with a Bokoblin Boss patrolling, find the cracked wall on the center pillar. Destroy it, and enter a secret area. Solution: 1. The puzzle here is actually finding the shrine. Treasure: - Hearty Elixir - Just before the end statue.

title: Mayam Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: 0340, 2814, 1821 - On top of the cross-shaped island. Shrine Quest: [The North Hyrule Sky Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277776) Treasure: - [Magic Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283444) - Just before the end statue

title: Turakawak Shrine
description: _Stacking a Path_ Location: -3496, -0197, 0066 - Down in Tabatha Frontier, on the shore of a lake, surrounded by thorns. Solution: 1. Ultrahand the block against the ledge, then climb it. 2. Once on the ledge, Attach both blocks vertically, and place them under the ladder to reach it. 3. Grab the first two blocks, and Attach them to the metal block, slightly offset. 4. Using the offset, Ascend through the blocks to the end statue. Treasure: - [Magic Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282786) - In a locked room. From the first high ledge, look up and Ascend through the fenced ceiling. Ascend again to get out.

title: Ikatak Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: -3950, 1138, 0112 - In an empty dry plain. Shrine Quest: [The Gisa Crater Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281683) Treasure: - Big Battery - Just before the end statue.

title: Iun-orok Shrine
description: _The Right Roll_ Location: -3538, 0853, -0133 - [Tanagar Canyon West Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278229) - At the far end of the cave, behind 3 thick cracked walls. Solution: 1. Ultrahand the ball on the slope so it rolls on the target. 2. Attach the two balls together, then place them on the angled slope. They should roll on both sides of the angle to the target. 3. Attach the three balls together, like a snowman. Ultrahand the snowman to the end of the curved slope, and drop it at the edge. It should fall and hit the target to the end statue. Treasure: - 10x Arrows - In the final room, on a high pillar. Slant the snowman against the pillar and jump from ball to ball to reach it.

title: Makurukis Shrine
description: _Combat Training: Archery_ Location: -2847, 0629, 0233 - On the cliff overlooking Tabantha Bridge stable, at the east end of Tabantha bridge. Solution: 1. Defeat the construct, following the on-screen prompts. Treasure: - [Strong Construct Bow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282771) - Just before the end statue.

title: Usazum Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: -2138, 0874, 0093 - In the field, west of Safula Hill. Shrine Quest: [The Satori Mountain Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281693) Treasure: - [Strong Zonaite Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282813) - Just before the end statue.

title: Tsutsu-um Shrine
description: _The Stakes Guide You_ Location: ?? - On a small hill overlooking [Outskirt Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277792). Solution: 1. Using Ultrahand, attach the platform to the pillar when it's at the bottom. 2. Climb on the platform and paraglide to the metal platform, using the fan to extend your air time. 3. Replace the 3 stakes as follows, so the giant ball goes into the hole: - In front of the ball's launching ramp, so it hits the stake and falls straight down. - Under the rotating platform, so it slants slightly downwards. - After the ball has fallen on the railing, on the rotating circle so it pushes the ball into the hole. Treasure: - 5x Arrows - On top of a pillar. When paragliding to the fan, take a sharp turn left on the pillar.

title: Gasas Shrine
description: _Well-Timed Cuts_ Location: -3079, 1617, 0243 - At the western end of Tabatha Canyon. Solution: 1. Shoot the rope to drop the metal cube and make a platform to the other side. 2. Grab the first metal cube, and Attach it to the second to create a staircase to the higher ledge. 3. Attach both plates end-to-end to make a bridge to the other side. 4. Attach the metal cube to one end of the bridge to create a counterweight. Then, place the bridge in the western alcove. 5. Shoot the hanging chest on the bridge. Use the Small Key inside to open the door. 6. Using Ultrahand, swing the large ball side-to-side, and shoot the rope when the momentum is right. The ball should drop in the socket and open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - Large Zonai Charge - Before the Small Key door, hanging above the chasm. Place the bridge under it before shooting the rope.

title: Kudanisar Shrine
description: _Bridging the Sands_ Location: -4168, -2140, 0050 - On top of the rock plateau Solution: 1. Make your way to the ledge with the light ahead. Be mindful of your stamina, and take breaks on the flowing wooden platforms. 2. Attach 2 of these platforms to form a longer one, and use it to get past the fence. 3. Ultrahand the vertical board away, then destroy the construct hiding behind. 4. Repeat step 2 to get to the ladder, then press the pressure plate. This should launch a small ball to the other side of the room. 5. Paraglide to the lower ledge, and pilot a boat to the other side of the room. Ascend through the ledge and destroy the construct. 6. Attach the ball to one of the boats, then press the pressure plate to lower the gate. Pilot the boat back to first boat platform. 7. Attach boards end-to-end to create a ramp to the stairs. Drop the ball in the socket to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - Hasty Elixir - On top of a pillar, guarded by a construct. When piloting the sand boat, turn right to notice the pillar.

title: Mayamats Shrine
description: _A Route for a Ball_ Location: -4639, -1510, 0452 - On the edge of the cliff Solution: 1. Glide to the higher ledge with the air flow. 2. Ascend to the ledge on the left and Ultrahand the ball down. 3. Place the ball in the V-shaped groove in the right wall, then Ascend through it. 4. Recall the smaller ball when it's just above the rail, then immediately cancel it; it should drop on the rail and into the basket. 5. Attach both balls together and place them on the rail in the first room. They should slide down, but not fall into the hole. 6. Dislodge the smaller ball into the socket to open the door to the end statue. Treasure: - Large Zonai Charge - After first grabbing the ball, place it in the pit in front of the wind current. Use the ball as a platform to the ledge with the chest.

title: Otutsum Shrine
description: _Rauru's Blessing_ Location: -4468, -0670, 0509 - In plain sight, between two mountain peaks. Solution: 1. Walk to the end statue. Treasure: - Topaz - Just before the end statue.

title: Rakashog Shrine
description: _A Reflective Device_ Location: -1713, -2120, -1149 - On a small, lonely island. Solution: 1. Ultrahand the mirror by the door, and place it in the beam of light so it hits the hexagon. This should open the door. 2. In the next room, Ultrahand the mirror through the window in the bars. Hold it high in the beam of light, facing right, so it hits the hexagon and opens the door. 3. Before traversing, send the light beam through the door. On the other side, angle the mirror down so it hits the hexagon and activates the elevator. 4. Defeat both constructs. Then, use a mirror to reflect the light beam on either side of the stone slab. Use the other to reflect it on the hexagon, opening the door to the end statue. Treasure: - Large Zonai Charge - After activating the elevator, place the mirror down so the light beam gets reflected upwards. Use the mirror on the upper platform to activate the hexagon and reach the chest.

title: Rotsumamu Shrine
description: _A Balanced Plan_ Location: -3405, -1365, 0335 - Beside the chasm, under a ledge. Solution: 1. Run up the seesaw to the higher ledge. 2. Attach the metal barrel to the raised end of the seesaw, then use it to climb to the higher ledge. 3. Extend the raised end of the seesaw with the slab, and attach the metal cube to it. Then, grab a cube from the lowered end and place it on the other end. This should swap the seesaw and allow access to the end statue. Treasure: - Large Zonaite - Past the 3rd seesaw; place the slab to create a bridge and jump to the ledge with the chest.

title: Ren-iz Shrine
description: _Jump the Gaps_ Location: 0756, 0823, 0082 - In the remains of a massive carved-out tree Solution: 1. Ultrahand the metal plate, and prop it against the top of the raised wall. It should be slanted slightly upwards. 2. Activate the pillar to drop a ball; it should roll down and hit your makeshift ramp to the hole. Adjust as necessary. 3. In the next room, Attach both metal plates together to form a giant L shape. Drop the L in front of the hole to form another ramp. 4. Activate the pillar to drop the ball and open the gate to the end statue. Treasure: - [Strong Zonaite Shield [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280424) - In the 2nd room, before forming the L shape, Attach both plates into a long bridge. Use it to reach the chest just right of the entrance.

title: Kyokugon Shrine
description: _Alignment of the Circles_ Location: -0710, -1550, 0006 - Inside [Great Plateau Foothill Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277823) (break through the large barrier of black stone) Solution: 1. Place the 4 balls into the correct sockets. To identify them, look up to the ceiling. Treasure: - Hearty Elixir - In the final room, use Ultrahand to notice a moveable slab in the floor, concealing a ball socket. Place a ball in it to open the door to the chest.

title: Jiukoum Shrine
description: _Built for Rails_ Location: On top of the mountain. Solution: 1. Attach both plates together, then place them horizontally on the wide rails. Ride them to the next platform. 2. Attach the three square plates into a "U" shape. Place it upside down on the rails and ride it to the next platform. 3. Attach the plates here into an "E" shape. Then, place it on the rails so the top and bottom plates are within the rails. Finally, Attach a Fan above each plate, and activate them to ride your contraption to the end statue. Treasure: - Sticky Elixir - Before the second set of rails, on a high ledge. Attach the platforms into a ramp to the chest.

title: Riogok Shrine
description: _Force Transfer_ Location: -1440, -1616, 0089 - Solution: 1. Ultrahand the pipe and attach it to the two cogs. Hit the crystal to open the gate. 2. After entering the next room, turn around and Rewing the cog. While Rewind is active, dislodge the pipe and bring it with you. 3. Ultrahand the pipe to the small lever, and move it to the left to open the gate. 4. Bring all 3 pipes to the higher platform, then Ascend to it. 5. One by one, Attach the pipes underneath the higher platform. 6. Once all 3 pipes are attached, Ascend to the higher platform to the end statue. Treasure: - [Mighty Construct Bow [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280396) - In the 2nd room, on a high ledge. Using Ultrahand, attach 2 pipes together, then attach the chest to this long pipe and bring it to the ground.

title: Jojon Shrine
description: _Proving Grounds: Rotation_ Location: Inside [Crenel Peak Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277820), behind a large barrier of breakable rocks. Solution: 1. Defeat all 5 constructs, using only the gear provided in the room. Treasure: - [Magic Rod [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280401) - Right before the end statue.

title: Mayachideg Shrine
description: _Proving Grounds: The Hunt_ Location: 0705, -0865, 0031 - On a tall rocky ledge. Solution: 1. Defeat all constructs using only the gear provided within. Treasure: - [Captain III Spear](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281644) - Just before the end statue.

title: Jochi-iu Shrine
description: _Courage to Pluck_ Location: 4346, 2875, 0165 - In plain sight, north of the road. Solution: 1. Using Ultrahand, remove 2 metal blocks from the gigantic Jenga puzzle. Make sure the blocks you take do not unbalance the structure. 2. Use the metal blocks to close the circuit, powering the platform. 3. Ride the platform to reach the Ball, and grab it with Ultrahand. 4. Place the ball in the socket to open the gate to the end statue. title: To The Kingdom of Hyrule
description: How To Begin: Interact with the glowing light at the end of the platform. Requirements: [The Closed Door](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279111) Reward: Access to the Surface world.

title: Crisis at Hyrule Castle

description: How to Begin: Speak with Yona. Requirements: Complete [The Sludge-Covered Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279574). Reward: Zora Armor

title: Tulin of Rito Village
description: How to Begin: Speak with Teba. Requirements: Started [Regional Phenomena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277708). Reward: [Vow of Tulin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279571)

title: Yunobo of Goron City
description: How to Begin: Speak with the village elder. Requirements: Started [Regional Phenomena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277708) Reward: [Vow of Yunobo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279573)

title: The Sludge-Covered Statue
description: How to Begin: Speak with a villager in Zora's Domain. Requirements: Started [Regional Phenomena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277708). Reward: None

title: Riju of Gerudo Town
description: How to Begin: Speak with the villagers in the underground shelter. Use the [Gerudo Shelter Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279350) to access the hideout. Requirements: Started [Regional Phenomena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277708). Reward: [Vow of Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279577)

title: Trail of the Master Sword
description: How to Begin: Automatic upon fulfulling the requirements. Requirements: Complete [Guidance From Ages Past](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=287480) Reward: Location of the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279408)

title: Guidance From Ages Past
description: How to Begin: Activate the Owl Mask behind the Heart Door north of [Joku-u Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278359). The heart door is located in the same room as the shrine. Requirements: Complete [Secret of the Ring Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290118) Reward: [Vow of Mineru, Sage of Spirit](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290057)

title: Find the Fifth Sage
description: How to Begin: Speak with Purah. Requirements: Advance [Crisis at Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277854) until after the first boss fight within Hyrule Castle. Reward: None

title: Secret of the Ring Ruins
description: How to Begin: Speak with Tauro Requirements: Start [Find the Fifth Sage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290117) Reward: None

title: Recovering the Hero's Sword
description: How to Begin: Speak with the Deku Tree Requirements: Complete [Trail of the Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=287479) Reward: [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279408)

description: How to Begin: Obtain the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279408) Requirements: Complete [Recovering the Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290119) Reward: Game completion!

description: How to get: Automatically obtained through the main quest.

title: The North Hyrule Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Mayam Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277775) Solution: - Defeat the [Flux Construct I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277777) on the sky island to the south and retrieve the crystal

title: The Oakle's Navel Cave Crystal
description: Location: Inside [Oakle's Navel Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278116) Associated Shrine: [Tokiy Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278119) Solution: Following the green beam of light, bring the crystal to the shrine, avoiding the rolling boulders.

title: The North Necluda Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Josiu Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278329) Solution: - Bring the [North Necluda Sky Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284237) back to the shrine.

title: The Gerudo Canyon Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Rakakudaj Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278152) Solution: - Return the [Gerudo Canyon Shrine Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279625)

title: The Lake Hylia Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [En-oma Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278371) Solution: Drop the [Lake Hylia Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283046) down the hole, then through the whirlpool and to the shrine.

title: The Death Caldera Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Momosik Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278218) Solution: Inside [Death Mountain East Tunnel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278221). Get on the minecart, and ride the rail until you reach the Igneo Talus waiting in the ground. Defeat it and bring the crystal back to the shrine.

title: Rock For Sale
description: How to Begin: Activate [Jochi-ihiga Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278375), then follow the green beam to Ruli in [Tarrey Town](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278088). Solution: After haggling the price for a bit, Ruli finally offers the mysterious glowing crystal for 50 Rupees. Pick up or use Ultrahand to transport your newly purchased Crystal to [Jochi-ihiga Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278375). Reward: - Unlocks: [Jochi-ihiga Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278375)

title: The Gisa Crater Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Ikatak Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277787) Solution: Follow the green light to the [Gisa Crater Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=286062) in [Gisa Crater Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278230) to the south. Use the nearby Rockets to propel the stone out of the crater.

title: The Satori Mountain Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Usazum Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277790) Solution: Defeat the Hinox in [Satori Mountain Foothill Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277791) and bring back the crystal to the shrine.

title: The Ralis Channel Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Joniu Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278644) Solution: Build a vehicle that can carry Link and the [Ralis Channel Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283432) upstream. Follow the river north and deliver the crystal to the shrine.

title: The South Hyrule Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Jinodok Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278351) Solution: - Return the [South Hyrule Sky Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281925) from the island to the north-west

title: The East Hebra Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Taninoud Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278355) Solution: - Using the nearby platform and Fans, head to the [East Hebra Sky Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283443), then bring it back to the shrine.

title: The Lake Intenoch Cave Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Moshapin Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278869) Location: [Lake Intenoch Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282018) - Beyond a cracked wall, just right of the entrance. Grab the Hydrant lying left of the crystal, and use it to cool the lava into a bridge up to the shrine.

title: The High Spring and the Light Rings
description: Associated Shrine: [Zakusu Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277954) Solution: Activate this terminal, then surf down the ledge and on the mountain. Surf through all the rings within the time limit. You can use the Sled Shield near the terminal to make it easier.

title: The North Hebra Mountain Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Sisuran Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278368) Solution: Defeat the [Frost Talus](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280975) and bring his crystal back to the shrine.

title: The Northwest Hebra Cave Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Rutafu-um Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278369) Solution: Bring the crystal from the bottom of the freezing pond within the cave. Attach an Icicle to a rock, then quickly attach it to the crystal, which should rise. You can then grab it with Ultrahand to the shrine.

title: Ride the Giant Horse
description: Associated Shrine: [Ishokin Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278370) Solution: Ride the [Giant Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283044) and bring it back to Baddek. Then bring the Shrine Crystal to the shrine down the hill.

title: Keys Born of Water
description: Associated Shrine: [Jochisiu Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278372); Speak with the Steward Construct by the stone structure. Solution: Using the nearby Frost Emitter or Ice Fruit arrows, create 3 ice platforms from the lake. Then, place each platform in the diamond-shaped slots on the pillars, melting the platforms to fit each slot size.

title: Legend of the Soaring Spear
description: Associated Shrine: [Utojis Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278125) Solution: Read the journal found at the bottom of [Toblo's Hollow Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281959) to start the quest. Pick up one of the nearby Zonaite Spears and fuse a Keese Wing to it. Then, step on the platform and throw the spear into the glowing circle. Coordinates: 1206, -2490. 0096

title: The Lanayru Road Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [O-ogim Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277953) Solution: Bring the [Lanayru Road Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283079) back to the shrine. You may use the nearby ramp to launch a Wing to the shrine.

title: The White Bird's Guidance
description: Associated Shrine: [Wao-os Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278382) Solution: - Stand on top of Vah Medoh's perch between 5-7am and look to the West. As the sun rises, Vah Medoh's perch will cast a shadow and align under a patch of snow in the shape of a bird. Glide over to that location and you will find the West Lake Totori Cave entrance. Travel through the cave to find the Wao-os Shrine and complete the quest!

title: Dyeing to Find It
description: Associated Shrine: [Kurakat Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277763) Solution: - Talk to the Steward Construct to start the quest. - Look on the other side of the gap to see a white pattern on the rock face. The pattern resembles the shape of the stone column on your side of the gap. - The objective is to alter the shape of the column's shadow so that when it falls on the white pattern it has roughly the same shape. - You can change the shape of the column's shadow by using some combination of turning it using the wheel nearby and/or attaching one or two boards to it. - Wait until morning. At approximately 6:00 AM the column's shadow will fall on the white pattern. If it has roughly the same shape, the shrine will appear.

title: A Pretty Stone and Five Golden Apples
description: Associated Shrine: [Pupunke Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278379) Solution: Bring Dania five Golden Apples. If you don't have them, you may follow the path to [Mido Swamp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277402), where two Golden Apple trees hold 6 apples in total. Then, bring the crystal to the shrine.

title: None Shall Pass?
description: Associated Shrine: [Sakunbomar Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278380) Solution: Destroy the [Stone Talus](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282023), then bring its crystal back to the shrine.

title: Maca's Special Place
description: Associated Shrine: [Ninjis Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278377) Solution: Reach the shrine by diving from above it.

title: The Sky Mine Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Gikaku Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278345) Solution: - Activate the nearby terminal, then use the launchers to asend the cross-shaped platforms to the [Sky Mine Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283447). Bring it back to the shrine.

title: The Sokkala Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Natak Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278364) Solution: - Use the nearby launcher to reach the [Sokkala Sky Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283449). Then, using the device inside, pivot the opening back towards the shrine and send the crystal to it.

title: The Tabantha Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Ganos Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278357) Solution: - Defeat the [Flux Construct III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279853) and bring his crystal back to the shrine.

title: The South Lanayru Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Mayanas Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278360) Solution: - Bring the [South Lanayru Shrine Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284235) back to the shrine.

title: The West Necluda Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Ukoojisi Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278349) Solution: - Bring the [West Necluda Sky Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290414) back to the shrine.

title: The Necluda Sky Crystal
description: Associated Shrine: [Kumamayn Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278346) Solution: - Defeat the [Flux Construct III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279852) on the nearby island to the east.

title: Hestu's Concerns
description: Previous Side Adventure: None How To Begin: Speak to [Hestu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279556) Reward: Unlocks Inventory Upgrades Next Side Adventure: None

title: Messages from an Ancient Era
description: Previous Side Adventure: None How To Begin: Speak with Wortsworth Reward: [Zonai Survey Team Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283921) Next Side Adventure: None

title: Potential Princess Sightings
description: How To Begin: Speak to [Traysi](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277845) in the [Lucky Clover Gazette](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276842) headquarters. Kickoff Link's career as a journalist! Your first news assignment is investigating possible sightings of the missing Princess Zelda. Starting this will unlock additional Side Adventures across Hyrule: - [Serenade to a Great Fairy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279983) - [The Beast and the Princess](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280074) - [White Goats Gone Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280075) - [Zelda's Golden Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280101) - [An Eerie Voice](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280110) - [The Beckoning Woman](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280366) - [The All-Clucking Cucco](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280392) - [Gourmets Gone Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281249) - [The Missing Farm Tools](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281257) - [Princess Zelda Kidnapped?!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282177) - [For Our Princess!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280509) - [The Blocked Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282420) Note: Rewards for these additional Side Adventures are based on your "base pay" as a journalist. Each completed Side Adventure for the Gazette will increase compensation, starting at 50 Rupees. Reward: - [Lucky Clover Gazette](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282907) (Paraglider Fabric) - [Froggy Hood](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277847) - [Froggy Sleeve](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281121) - [Froggy Leggings](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281122)

title: The Search For Koltin

title: Serenade to a Great Fairy
description: How To Begin: Begin [Potential Princess Sightings](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277846), then meet up with Penn at [Woodland Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279491) A musical troupe called [The Stable Trotters](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279499) claim they've seen a blonde girl shut herself inside a flower bud. Penn suspects this might be Princess Zelda. Perhaps the flower bud will open if the blonde woman hears music? You need to bring The Stable Trotters to the [Great Fairy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279490) flower bud. But, to do that, you must first repair their cart and find a horse to pull it. Reward: Rupees, amount depends on your "base pay" for the Lucky Clover Gazette Next Side Adventure: - [Serenade to Cotera](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279990) - [Serenade to Mija](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280073) - [Serenade to Kaysa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280108)

title: Serenade to Cotera
description: How To Begin: 1. Speak with Mastro at the [Dueling Peaks Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279177) outdoor stage The Stable Trotters are eager to play their music for Great Fairy Cotera, but they can't cross the bridge! Use Ultrahand to solve this transportation crisis. After successfully crossing the river, guide the cart to Great Fairy Cotera. Reward: - 100 Rupees - Unlocks: [Great Fairy Cotera](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279483) Next Side Adventure: - [Serenade to Mija](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280073) - [Serenade to Kaysa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280108)

title: Serenade to Kaysa
description: How To Begin: 1. Complete [Serenade to a Great Fairy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279983) & [The Flute Player's Plan](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280107) 2. Speak with Mastro at the [Outskirt Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277792) The Stable Trotters are larger to play their music for Great Fairy Kaysa, but their trusty wagon is in disrepair, and there doesn't seem to be the usual wagon wheels nearby. Leaning against a boulder, there's a stone and Zonai tech cart you can repair. Use Ultrahand to put the missing wheel back, and attach the Zonai controller on top. Then, Place the Stable Trotter's wagon on top of the stone slab. Reward: - 100 Rupees - Unlocks: [Great Fairy Kaysa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279489) Next Side Adventure: - [Serenade to Cotera](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279990) - [Serenade to Mija](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280073)
