Reward: - Monster Extract - Monster Bridle Next Side Adventure: [A Monstrous Collection IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283882)

title: Bring Peace to Hebra!
description: Previous Side Adventure: [Bring Peace to Faron!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282430) How To Begin: Speak with Flaxel Reward: - Silver Rupee - [Monster-Control-Crew Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284645) (if all 6 _Bring Peace_ side adventures have been completed) Next Side Adventure: None

title: A Monstrous Collection IV
description: Previous Side Adventure: [A Monstrous Collection III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282916) How To Begin: Talk to Kilton. Reward: - Monster Extract - Monster Saddle Next Side Adventure: [A Monstrous Collection V](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283883)

title: A Monstrous Collection V
description: Previous Side Adventure: [A Monstrous Collection IV](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283882) How To Begin: Talk to Kilton. Reward: - Monster Extract - Diamond

title: The Long Dragon
description: Previous Side Adventure: [Investigate the Thyphlo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281616) How To Begin: Investigate the right-most slab after obtaining [Vow of Riju](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279577) Reward: [Topaz x3 [Chest[](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290438) Next Side Adventure: ??

title: The Six Dragons
description: Previous Side Adventure: [Investigate the Thyphlo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281616) How To Begin: Examine the 2rd right-most stone slab after obtaining [Vow of Sidon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279575). Reward: [Opal x5 [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290437) Next Side Adventure: None

title: The Corridor between Two Dragons
description: Previous Side Adventure: [Investigate the Thyphlo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281616) How To Begin: Examine the 2nd left-most stone slab after obtaining [Vow of Yunobo](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279573). Reward: [Ruby x3 [Chest]](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=289742) Next Side Adventure: None

title: Bring Peace To Eldin!
description: Previous Side Adventure: None How To Begin: Talk to Toren. Reward: Silver Rupee Next Side Adventure: [Bring Peace to Akkala!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282619)

title: Horse-Drawn Dreams
description: How to Begin: Speak to [Zumi](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276879) Solution: First, Ultrahand two of the nearby wheels on the wagon to repair it. Then, you need to tame a wild horse to pull the cart. Wild horses can be found grazing east of the stables. Ride the horse back to Zumi. Reward: - Silver Rupee

title: Teach Me A Lesson I
description: How To Begin: Speak to Symin multiple times in [Hateno School](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276899) after the school day has begun (9:00 AM). Solution: Go to [Kakariko Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276821) and head for Paya's House. Look for the tapestry on the 2nd floor and take a picture of it. Reward: Hylian Rice x10

title: Dantz's Prize Cows
description: How To Begin: Speak to Dantz, who's pacing around outside [Hateno Pasture](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276895). He only needs three acorns. Reward: Fresh Milk

title: Seeking the Pirate Hideout
description: How To Begin: Speak to Sesami (located by the red tent on Toronbo Beach) Reward: Blue-Maned Lynel Saber Horn

title: Piaffe, Packed Away
description: How to Begin: Speak to Piaffe inside the stable. Solution: Destroy all the boxes in the stable. Reward: 1x Pony Point

title: A Picture For The Closed Stable I
description: How To Begin: Examine the empty picture frame in front of Piaffe after completing [Piaffe, Packed Away](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276949) Solution: Head for [Rakashog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277801). On the arm of the island that points southwest, look down and take a picture. Reward: One Pony Point and some food.

title: A Picture For The Closed Stable II
description: How To Begin: Speak to Piaffe again after acquiring [A Picture For The Closed Stable I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276950). It is not necessary to complete it to get the second quest. Solution: The [Forgotten Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=286597) is right next to a [Frost Gleeok](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278165). A [Korok Seed](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280676) also marks the exact location. Reward: One Pony Point and some food.

title: The Incomplete Stable
description: How To Begin: Speak to Karson, near the horses, after completing the [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570). Objective: Complete the stable by using Ultrahand to attach the nearby plank onto the roof Reward: Unlocks the [Mini Stable at Lookout Landing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277031) Next Side Quest: [Spotting Spot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284885)

title: Mired in Muck
description: How To Begin: Speak to [Bazz](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277046), who's stuck in the mud in front of [Upland Zorana Skyview Tower](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276831) Steps To Complete: - Throw a Splash Fruit at him to free him from the mud (they can be found growing on the eastern side of the tower) Reward: Zora Spear

title: Today's Menu
description: How to Begin: Speak with Burmano in the Emergency Shelter. Solution: Give him an Apple Reward: Fruit and Mushroom Mix

title: Photographing a Chuchu
description: How To Begin: Speak to Sayge in [Kochi Dye Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276896) How To Complete: Use your camera to take a picture of a Chuchu _Note: If this is your first time meeting Sayge, then you may need to speak to him, leave, then speak again and will need to customize the paraglider at least once for him to give you the Side Quest._ Reward: [Chuchu Design](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279956)

title: The Treasure Hunters
description: How To Begin: Talk to Domidak Reward: 3 Flower Bombs

title: The Great Tumbleweed Purge
description: How To Begin: Speak to Barles at the small camp in the mountains. Task: Destroy all the nearby Tumbleweeds Reward: Royal Shield (55)

title: Eldin's Colossal Fossil
description: How To Begin: Speak to Loone on the path near East Akkala Stable Solution: - Find the [Eldin Great Skeleton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278384) - Replace the [Eldin Great Skeleton's Eye](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278385) - Speak with Loone to complete the quest; she relocated [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278386) Reward: Purple Rupee Next Side Quest: [Hebra's Colossal Fossil](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278386)

title: The Gathering Pirates
description: How to Begin: Speak with Aya, outside the stable. Solution: Defeat all the pirates near the [North Akkala Beach](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277104). Reward: - 2x Pony Point - Endura Carrot

title: Strongest in the World
description: How To Begin: Speak to Chabi outside [East Akkala Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277827) Task: Bring a Lynel Horn to Chabi. You may used the marked [Lynel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279233), or seek a stronger one for better rewards. Reward: - Purple, Silver or Gold Rupee, depending of the horn's quality.

title: The Lomei Labyrinth Island Prophecy
description: How to Begin: Interact with the terminal at the center of the [Lomei Labyrinth Island](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278302). Solution: - Reach the Lomei Sky Labyrinth, by the [Mogisari Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278365). - Activate each of the four terminals within the Sky Labyrinth: - [NW Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280419) - [NE Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280415) - [SW Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280418) - [SE Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280417) - A new terminal will spawn atop the labyrinth; interact with it to open the gate to the [Lomei Labyrinth Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278300); dive into it. - Defeat the [Flux Construct III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283117) to complete the quest. Reward: [Evil Spirit Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280412)

title: The Ancient City Gorondia!
description: How to Begin: Speak to Dugby beside the minecart railway Solution: Put his cart onto the mine track to the right and Attach a Fan to it. Speak with Dugby again, then ride the cart with him to YunoboHQ. Reward: Zonai Charge

title: Hebra's Colossal Fossil
description: How To Begin: Complete [Hebra's Colossal Fossil](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278386) and speak to Loone [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284462). Solution: - Find the [Hebra Great Skeleton](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284462) - Replace the fossil - Speak with Loone to complete the quest; she relocated [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284462) Reward: Purple Rupee Next Side Quest: [Gerudo's Colossal Fossil](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284462)

title: An Uninvited Guest
description: How To Begin: Talk to Ami at [Wetland Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279178) Clear the [Enemy Camp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279473) outside the [Wetland Stable South Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279333). You can use the [Wetland Stable Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279331) nearby to use the passage underground and sneak up behind the enemies! Reward: 2 Pony Points

title: Out of the Inn
description: How to Begin: Speak with Dai the Innkeeper at [Shuteye Inn](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276824) Solution: Find [Ollie](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284677), and bring him a Hearty Truffle. Some may be found in the nearby [Kakariko Village Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283291). Reward: Sticky Elixir

title: Codgers' Quarrel
description: How to Begin: Speak with Trissa the Shopkeeper at [High Spirits Produce](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276822) Solution: Clear the [Enemy Camp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284672), then speak with [Olkin](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284671) or [Steen](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284670) to bring them back to the village. Reward: Endura Carrot

title: A Trip through History
description: How to Begin: Speak with Bugut, a traveling historian wandering up and down the central road in Kakariko Village Solution: Read the four following slabs: 1. [Deciphered Slabs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279752) 2. [Deciphered Slabs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280168) 3. [Deciphered Slabs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284525) 4. [Deciphered Slabs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284675) Reward: Thunderwing Butterfly x3

title: Gloom-Borne Illness
description: How To Begin: Speak to Lasli, who typically sits by a [cooking pot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279469) Create a porridge to fight off the gloom that plagues Leslie's grandmother. Ingredients: - Hylian Rice - Fresh Milk - "Wild Greens" (Sundelion) Reward: - Energizing Veggie Porridge - Discounted prices at [Enchanted](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276825)

title: Meat For Meat
description: How to Begin: Speak with Mezer. Solution: Bring the [Marbled Rock Roast](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284499) back to Mezer. Make sure you have some Fireproof Elixir to enter the cave, and use the Hydrants in the cave to walk across the lava. Reward: Large Zonai Charge

title: Open the door
description: How To Begin: Knock the door or examine the small hole through side of house. Reward: - Spicy Elixer - Traveler's Shield - Unlocks: Shield Surfing Instructions

title: Disaster in Gerudo Canyon
description: How to Begin: Speak to Quince by the ruins Solution: Find his 3 lost friends in Gerudo Canyon: - [Giro](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279626) - [Garill](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279611) - [Botrick](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284627) Reward: 10x Bomb Flower

title: The Missing Owner
description: How to Begin: Speak to Cara in the Gerudo hideout shelter or Gerudo Jewelry Shop. Solution: 1. Head West out of town towards [Toruma Dunes](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277303) 2. Defeat the Molduga. 3. Return to the city and speak with Cara. Reward: - Diamond - Opens the Arms of the Seven

title: Amber Dealer
description: How to Begin: Talk to Ramella Solution: Bring her 10x Amber Reward: - 200 Rupees - [Ramella](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284498)'s ore trading service.

title: Manny's Beloved
description: How To Begin: Speak to Manny, who is hiding behind a pillar and staring at Ms. Ivee. Give him ten hot-footed frogs. Reward: 10 Rushrooms

title: Cave Mushrooms That Glow
description: How to Begin: Speak with Meghyn or Nat near [Brightcap Cave Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279994) Solution: Give the Meghyn and Nat 10x Brightcap. Enough may be found in the nearby [Brightcap Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279995) Reward: Spicy Tomato Mushroom Stew

title: Genli's Home Cooking
description: How to Begin: Speak to Genli after starting [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570). She can often be found inside [The Slippery Falcon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276845) General Store. Solution: Give Genli a Staminoka Bass to enhance her cooking. Reward: Biting Simmered Fruit

title: Molli the Fletcher's Quest
description: How to Begin: Speak to Molli after starting [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570). She can be found inside her cliffside house in Rito Village. Solution: Give Molli an Ice Fruit or a White Chuchu Jelly. Reward: 10x Arrow

title: Fell Into a Well!
description: How to Begin: Speak with Dillie, down the [Rebonae Bridge Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279330) Solution: Use Ultrahand to connect the broken part of the ladder on the ground, back to the ladder remaining above Reward: Purple Rupee

title: Crossing the Cold Pool
description: How to Begin: Talk to Verla at in front of the [Talonto Peak Cave Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280046). Solution: Bring 10x Chillshroom to Verla. Enough can be gathered from the [Talonto Peak Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280047). Reward: 50 Rupees

title: Teach me a Lesson II
description: How to Begin: Talk to Symin after completing [Teach Me A Lesson I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276905) Solution: Cook some Monster Curry using Hylian Rice, Goron Spice, and Monster Extract. Reward: Unlocks the next side quest: [Uma's Garden](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284453)

title: Where Are the Wells?
description: How to Begin: Talk to Fera inside the [Wetland Stable Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279331) (see Note). Solution: Find all 58 wells. For a well to be "found", Link must approach close enough for the prompt to appear in the lower left corner. Click [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?catIds=9063) to see the locations of all the wells. Reward: - 10 Rupees per well, up to 580 Rupees. - [All's Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284502) upon finding them all. Note: Fera may appear in many different wells and so this quest can be started in multiple locations. After starting the quest, Fera relocates to [Lookout Landing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276752)

title: Follow the Cuccos
description: How to Begin: Talk to Trissa after completing [Codgers' Quarrel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279463) Solution: Bring her 10x Bird Egg. You may find enough in [Cucco Hideaway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282061). Reward: Purple Rupee

title: Secrets Within
description: How to Begin: Talk to Pulcho. Solution: Use the [Device Dispenser](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280118) beside him. Reward: 1 Sundelion

title: Master the Vehicle Prototype
description: How to Begin: Talk to Fernison. Solution: Attach a Steering Stick to the nearby vehicle. The nearby [Device Dispenser](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280118) provides some. Then, complete the race within the time limit. Reward: Silver Rupee

title: The Blocked Cave
description: How to Begin: Talk to the Rito warrior, Mazli, standing outside the blocked cave. Solution: Blow open the [Rospro Pass Cave Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280283), either with bombs or a Boulder-type weapon. Reward: Red Rupee

title: The Horse Guard's Request
description: How to Begin: Talk to Toffa looking at the horses in the stable. Solution: - First, bring a Stalhorse to Toffa so he can see. The closest [Stalhorse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284493) can be found there. - Next, he wants to see a tamed animal that isn't a horse. The closest would be a honeyvore bear in Dalite Forest, to the northwest. Reward: - 2x Pony Points - A Purple Rupee and a Silver Rupee

title: Treasure of The Secret Springs
description: How to Begin: Talk to Tulin after completing [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570) Solution: Travel to [North Biron Snowshelf Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280464) and solve the puzzle by blasting out all the rocks in the cave. Reward: [Vah Medoh Divine Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280463)

title: Misko's Cave of Chests
description: How to Begin: Talk to Domidak in front of the [Cephla Lake Cave Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284501). Solution: Feed the nearby dog fruits or meat, then follow it as he picks the right chest. Reward: [Ember Trousers](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279831)

title: Misko's Treasure: The Fierce Deity
description: How to Begin: Pick up the message in the bottle after completing [Misko's Cave of Chests](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280696). Solution: Collect the full Fierce Deity set, then equip it in [Cephla Lake Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280697) - [Fierce Deity Boots](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279654) - [Fierce Deity Mask](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280133) - [Fierce Deity Armor](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280700) Reward: [Fierce Deity Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280702)

title: A New Champion's Tunic
description: How to Begin: Read Zelda's journal inside [Zelda's Secret Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279305) Solution: In Hyrule Castle's [Sanctum](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277516), light both braziers around the throne to reveal a secret room. Reward: [Champion's Leathers](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279434)

title: The Abandoned Laborer
description: How to Begin: Speak to Mota Solution: Build a cart with an explosive on the back to launch him across to where he needs to go Reward: Large Zonai Charge

title: The Captured Tent
description: How to Begin: Complete [Cave Mushrooms That Glow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279993) then talk to Nat and Meghyn at [Snowfield Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277694) Solution: Defeat the Monsters at [Mount Drena Foothill Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281042). 3x Bokoblins and 1 Moblin Reward: Spicy Steamed Mushrooms

title: Legacy of the Rito
description: How to Begin: Talk to Teba in Rito Village after completing [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570) Solution: Bring Teba a swallow bow, five bundles of wood, and three diamonds. Reward: Great Eagle Bow

title: The Rito Rope Bridge
description: How to Begin: After completing [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570), talk to Gesane standing next to the broken bridge to start the quest. Solution: You need to first go to [Lookout Landing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276752) and on the west side, talk to Karson to come and fix the bridge. Once you do that, you will need to meet with him and Gesane again here. Karson will ask for 20 bundles of wood so that he can fix the bridge. Reward: - Fixed bridge to Rito Village - Silver Rupee

title: Fish for Fletching
description: How to Begin: After completing [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570), talk to Bedoli in Rito Village. Solution: Bring 3x Glowing Cave Fish to Bedoli. Reward: - 10x Arrow - [Bedoli](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284494)'s trading service.

title: Soul of the Gorons
description: How to Begin: Complete [Yunobo of the Gorons](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279572) Solution: Deliver three diamonds, five flints, and one Cobble Crusher Reward: Boulder Breaker

title: The North Lomei Prophecy
description: How to Begin: Interact with the terminal at the center of the labyrinth. Solution: - Reach the North Lomei Castle Top Floor, by the [Tenbez Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278354). - Activate each of the four terminals within the Top Floor: - [North Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282918) - [South Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282919) - [East Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282922) - [Central Terminal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282917) - A new terminal will spawn atop the labyrinth; interact with it to open the gate to the [North Lomei Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281124); dive into it. - Defeat the [Flux Construct III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284497) to complete the quest. Reward: [Evil Spirit Greaves](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280876)

title: Kaneli's Flight Training
description: How to Begin: Speak with Kaneli after completing [Tulin of Rito Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279570) Solution: Pass through at least 15 rings in under 30 seconds. Reward: - Purple Rupee - [Advanced Flying Course](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283192)

title: WANTED: Hinox
description: How to Begin: Talk to Gralens in the Emergency Shelter and ask about big monsters Solution: Kill the [Hinox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279784) found northeast of [Lookout Landing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276752) at [Trilby Plain](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277397) Reward: - Silver Rupee - Gold Rupee, when all 3 _WANTED: XX_ quests are completed.

title: WANTED: Molduga
description: How to Begin: Talk to Gralens in the Emergency Shelter and ask about big monsters Solution: Kill the [Molduga in the East Barrens](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278134). Reward: - Silver Rupee - Gold Rupee, when all 3 _WANTED: XX_ quests are completed.

title: WANTED: Stone Talus
description: How to Begin: Talk to Gralens in the Emergency Shelter Solution: Kill the [Stone Talus in North Akkala Foothill](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283264) Reward: - Silver Rupee - Gold Rupee, when all 3 _WANTED: XX_ quests are completed.

title: The Iceless Icehouse
description: How to Begin: Speak with Anche, within the Icehouse. Solution: Make an ice block in the pool (using an ice weapon, an Ice Fruit or a White Chuchu Jelly). Then, Throw a fire Fruit on it until it shrinks small enough to fit on the shelf. Reward: Purple Rupee

title: A Bottled Cry For Help
description: How to Begin: Read bottled message Solution: Head to [Mapla Point Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281060) and remove the boulder blocking the entrance to a deeper part of the cave. Reward: A Silver (100) Rupee

title: Moon-Gazing Gorons
description: How to Begin: Speak to a pair of elderly Gorons after completing [Yunobo of Goron City](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279572) Solution: Go to [Lake Ferona Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282529) just before midday. Get to a high vantage point and snap a picture of the circular light on the ground as it shines on the stone Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Ousting the Giants
description: How to Begin: Talk to Kampo, just outside the stable. Solution: - Defeat each of the following Hinoxes: - [The Youngest Hinox Brother](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282069), in [Rodai Lakefront Tunnel](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282070) - [The Middle Hinox Brother](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281890), in [Corta Lake Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281893) - [The Eldest Hinox Brother](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277997), in [Calora Lake Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277995) Reward: Mighty Fried Bananas

title: Feathered Fugitives
description: How to Begin: Finish [Gourmets Gone Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281249) and talk to Teli Solution: Find the five missing Cuccos in the area. Their locations are: - Inside the stable - On top of the stable, all the way atop the horsehead chimney - On a very small rock formation in the river - Near the stage - In a tree next to Endai (he will remark upon it, giving you the clue) Reward: Silver Rupee

title: The Duchess Who Disappeared
description: How to Begin: Talk to Selmie in the [East Biron Snowshelf Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281623). Solution: Speak with Selmie back on [Selmie's Spot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280510). Reward: [Strong Zonaite Shield](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284496)

title: Mine-Cart Land: Open for Business!
description: How to Begin: Talk to Bayge in the Southern Mine Solution: Ride the cart and shoot 5 balloons. Play again and hit 7 balloons. Reward: Hit 5 targets to earn 20 rupees. Hit 7 targets to earn 50 rupees.

title: Homegrown in Hateno
description: How to Begin: Talk to Mayor Reede in the field. Only available after [The Mayoral Election](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282891) Solution: Defend the crops from waves of Stals until morning or until you kill all the waves of Stal type enemies. Reward: Sun Pumpkins x5

title: Who Finds the Haven?
description: How to Begin: Complete [The Captured Tent](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280957) Solution: Go to [Sturnida Springs Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280478) and find the Mushroom Haven Reward: Mushrooms in the cave: - Big Hearty Truffle - 3x Hearty Truffle - 14x Brightcap - 5x Rushroom - 4x Chillshroom - 4x Stamella Shroom

title: The Ultimate Dish?
description: How to Begin: Speak to Moza at the bottom of [Rikoha Hills Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279325) Solution: Give her dubious food and 5 rupees Reward: Monster Stew

title: A Picture for Outskirt Stable
description: How to Begin: Interact with empty frame Solution: Take a picture of a cherry blossom tree north of Sartori Mountain Reward: - 1 Pony Point - Egg Tart

title: Cash in on Ripened Flint
description: How to Begin: Complete [Meat for Meat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279494) and talk to a Goron at a table Solution: Give 20 - 100 Flint, random chance it will be ripened flint. 50 is the recommended number to give. Reward: 1,000 rupees

title: Gleeok Guts
description: How to Begin: Speak to Malena Solution: Bring 1 Gleeok Guts to her Reward: Gold Rupee

title: One-Hit Wonder!
description: How to Begin: Speak to Parcy Solution: Break the Rock in 1 hit (can use a bomb) Reward: ??

title: Home on Arrange
description: How to Begin: Complete [Mattison's Independence](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280181) first, then speak to Rhondson. Solution: Cough up 1,500 rupees, then get to the plot of land next to [Rasitakiwak Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277436) to speak to Granteson. Reward: The ability to build your dream home, and [Hudson Construction Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283063)

title: Lost in the Dunes
description: How to Begin: Talk to Benja. Available after main story progression in the region. Solution: Head to the Source of the Oasis Cave, a sand sinkhole southwest of the oasis. Talk to Ponthos and then make your way through the cave bombing the rocks. Once you reach the ladder, Ponthos will talk to you and tell you to meet him outside. Reward: One of the orbs needed for The Mysterious Eight side quest

title: Lurelin Resort Project
description: How to Begin: Talk to Bolson after completing [Lurelin Village Restoration Project](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282395) Solution: Complete both [Master the Vehicle Prototype](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280180) and [The Tarrey Town Race Is On!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283894). Then, speak with Tali and Shabonne at the Construction Site. Reward: [Lurelin Water Rally](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284659)

title: Rattled Ralera
description: How to Begin: Talk to Ralera after completing [Lurelin Village Restoration Project](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282395) Solution: 1. Make her a Mighty Seafood Curry, using the following ingredients: - A Mighty Porgy, available for purchase on the docks of Lurelin Village; - Goron Spice, available at Goron's City [General Store](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276855); - Hylian Rice, obtainable by cutting grass all across Hyrule. 2. Summon a gust of wind, either by using a Fan or using a board-fused weapon. Reward: [Lurelin Village Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284654)

title: Dad's Blue Shirt
description: How to Begin: Talk to Zuta after completing [Lurelin Village Restoration Project](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282395) Solution: Build a raft and grab the [Island Lobster Shirt](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280844) out of the water. Reward: You keep the shirt!

title: A Picture for Dueling Peaks Stable
description: How to Begin: Start the quest by examining the empty frame in [Dueling Peaks Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279177). Solution: Take a picture of the sunrise at the summit of Tuft Moutain, the same place where you get a [Korok Seed](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278265). Reward: - 1x Pony Point - Food (?)

title: A Picture for the Wetland Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty painting frame. Solution: Take a picture of a ring shape ruin and bring it to the stablemaster in [Wetland Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279178). Reward: - 1x Pony Point - Electro Elixir

title: The South Lomei Prophecy
description: How to Begin: Access the terminal in the middle of the labyrinth. Solution: Go to the [South Lomei Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278358) and access all five terminals. Dive into the [South Lomei Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280841) into the Depths. Defeat the [Flux Construct III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284443) in the [South Lomei Depths Labyrinth](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277946). Reward: [Evil Spirit Mask](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280877)

title: A Picture for Riverside Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty picture frame. Solution: Take a picture of a Great Goddess Statue and show it to the stablemaster. There are at least five that count: - [The Temple of Time](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280926) - [The Goddess Statue of Courage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281483) - [The Goddess Statue of Wisdom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281636) - [The Goddess Statue of Power](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282003) - [The Mother Goddess Statue](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284473) Reward: - 1x Pony Point - Energizing Crab Stir-Fry

title: The Heroines' Secret
description: How to Begin: Speak to Rotana in the Gerudo shelter. She wants you to take pictures of some writing for her. All are located in the stronghold. Solution: 1. Take off your clothes and you will be put in jail. Take a picture of the writing on the back wall. 2. In the training room. Break the boulders. -3891, -2996, 0032 3. Past the classroom and into where they keep the sand seals. Ultrahand piece that is separated and insert into plaque. -3848, -2944, 0029 4. In the classroom. In two pieces. Stand on stool or back to grid coordinates to take a picture. -3858, 2982, 0032 Reward: 100 Rupees

title: A Picture for Tabantha Bridge Stable
description: How to Begin: Interact with empty frame in [Tabantha Bridge Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277814) Solution: Take a picture of the Ancient Columns at sunrise. Avoid or kill the [Flame Gleeok](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280461). Reward: One Pony Point and Hasty Elixir.

title: The Mysterious Eighth
description: Location -3824, -2970, 0029 How to Begin: Speak to Rotana in the Gerudo stronghold. She wants you to find the 8 orbs and place them in their statue that correlates to in their hands. Solution: You need to put the orbs in the statues hands. The symbol on the orb c 1. In main hall. -3887, -2971, 0033 2. Shelter Inn area above. Use Ascend -3913, -2929, 0037 3. Shelter Bar. Sandstorm must be cleared. -3904, -2915, 0030. 4. West of the main entrance. Sandstorm must be cleared. Beat the girls game. -3818, -2878, 0043 5. East of the main gate. -3782, -2900, 0047 6. On top of a destroyed building. You have to blow sand away. -3802, -2966, 0057 7. Located at the Kara Kara bazaar. You have to complete the quest where you have to find the missing 3rd guy. After that you can take the ball. -3273, -2582, 0023 Reward: - Topaz, Sapphire, Ruby and Diamond - A full set of gerudo weapons and a shield - Gold Rupee

title: Whirly Swirly Things
description: How to Begin: Speak with Kula Solution: Show Kula a photo of a whirlpool in water. - One can be found at the entrance to Zora Waterworks. - Kula will then ask for a photo of a sand sinkhole. - Show Kula a photo of the sand sinkhole. One can be found in Gerudo Desert locations, like the Oasis Source. Reward: Endura Carrots x5

title: To the Ruins!
description: How to Begin: Speak to Pokki at the east gate Solution: 1. Speak with her again and she will want to ride with you. 2. Rent a seal with sled and speak to her again. 3. Head east to the [East Gerudo Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=286552) at coordinates -2789, -2851, 0023 Reward: 100 Rupees

title: The Tarrey Town Race Is On!
description: How to Begin: Speak with Fernison after completing [Master the Vehicle Prototype](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280180). Solution: Complete the race within 2 minutes. You may use any vehicle, as long as you use Fernison's Steering Stick. Reward: - 3x Zonai Charge - [Tarrey Town Race](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278094) minigame

title: Pride of the Gerudo
description: How to Begin: Speak to Isha after completing [The Missing Owner](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279845). Solution: 1. Bring her 4 diamonds, 10 flint, a Gerudo Scimitar and a Gerudo Shield. 2. All these items can be found around the desert. Also in Temple of the Eighth. Reward: Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker

title: The Blue Stone
description: How to Begin: Speake to Ledo after the main quest Solution: Build a boat and go to Reservoir Lakefront Cavern and bring a blue stone back to Ledo Reward: [Zora Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283905)

title: The Fort at Ja'Abu Ridge
description: How to Begin: Speak to Gaddison (found wandering the bridge). Solution: Clear the [enemy fortress](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=286620) Reward: 100 Rupees

title: The Never-Ending Lecture
description: How to Begin: Speak to Chroma after completing [Sidon of the Zora](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277434) Solution: Retrieve the Zora Helm Reward: [Zora Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279275)

title: Secret Treasure under the Great Fish
description: How to Begin: Speak to Sidon after completing [Sidon of the Zora](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277434) Solution: Retrieve the Vah Ruta Divine Helm Reward: [Vah Ruta Divine Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280782)

title: The Moonlit Princess
description: How to Begin: Speak to Seggin Solution: Take a picture of the Mipha statue at Shatterback Point at night and show him. Reward: Zora Sword

title: True Treasure
description: How to Begin: Speak to Kodah at the Inn Solution: Go to [Tarm Point Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279803) and take Sasan to the other side. Reward: 2x Opal

title: Mine-Cart Land: Death Mountain
description: Previous Side Quest: [Mine-Cart Land: Quickshot Course](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284289) How To Begin: Speak to Kabetta Reward: [Goron Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283913)

title: Glory of the Zora
description: How To Begin: Speak to Dento and give him three diamonds, five pieces of flint, and a Zora Spear. Reward: Lightscale Trident

title: A Crabulous Deal
description: How to Begin: Speak with Cleff Solution: Give him 10x Bright-Eyed Crabs. Reward: Sapphire

title: A Wife Wafted Away
description: How to Start: Speak to Fronk after the main quest. Solution: Go back up to Wellsprings Island, either by the waterfall or by teleporting to [Igoshon Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278363). To the southeast of the shrine, a campfire can be seen. Talk to Mei. Reward: Hearty Fish Skewer,

title: A Token of Friendship
description: How to Begin: Speak to Yona after completing [Sidon of the Zora](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277434) Solution: Retrieve the Zora Greaves Reward: [Zora Greaves](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279700)

title: The Secret Room
description: How to Begin: Ascend into the tree's mouth and speak with Oaki. Solution: Give him 4x Nightshade and 2x Giant Brightbloom Seeds. Reward: [Korok Fabric](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284221)

title: Rock Roast or Dust
description: How to Begin: Complete [Yunobo of Goron City](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279572) and speak to Cooke Solution: Go to the East Restaurant Cave. At the end of the cave will be the Rock Roast. Bring one back (Bringing more than one will despawn the others as soon as you present one to Cooke) and drop it in front of the counter Reward: Seared Gourmet Steak

title: Walton’s Treasure Hunt
description: How to Begin: Ascend to the top of the Deku tree. Solution: - Find the Forest Dweller’s Sword right behind Walton above. - Find the Forest Dweller’s Spear in front Walton behind a thick trunk near the rim. - Report back to Walton. - Go down to the ground, and find the Forest Dweller’s Shield leaning on top of the tree’s entrance. Reward: - Forest Dweller’s Sword - Forest Dweller’s Spear - Forest Dweller’s Shield - Forest Dweller’s Bow

title: Misko's Treasure of Awakening I
description: How to Begin: Read the tablet inside of [Goronbi River Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280705), which is revealed after opening the chest containing the [Ember Shirt](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280706). Solution: Open the [Ancient Columns Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280853). Reward: [Tunic of Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280855)

title: Mine-Cart Land: Death Mountain
description: How to Begin: Complete [Mine-Cart Land: Quickshot Course](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284289) with the best result. Speak to Kabetta. Solution: 8 targets within 2 minutes Reward: Goron Fabric

title: Mine-Cart Land: Quickshot Course
description: How to Begin: Complete [Mine-Cart Land: Open for Business!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282332) with the best result. Speak to Heehl Solution: Seven targets within 1:20 Reward: 50 Rupees

title: Heat-Endurance Contest!
description: How to Begin: Talk to Rahdo after beating the [Cold-Endurance Contest!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=284321) side quest and pay 150 rupees. Solution: Survive the heat for one day in your underwear. Tips: - Have a minimum of twenty-five hearts to win legitimately - Equip an ice infused weapon or shield - Eat some heat-resistant food Reward: Gold Rupee.

title: Cold-Endurance Contest!
description: How to Begin: Talk to Rahdo on top of the mountain and pay 50 Rupees. Solution: Survive a night in the cold, without using clothing. Tips: - Have a minimum of twenty-five hearts to win legitimately. - Equip a fire infused weapon or shield - Eat food or start a fire Reward: Silver Rupee.

title: A Picture for Highland Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty painting Solution: Take a picture of the [Giant White Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283044) Reward: 1 Pony Point and some food

title: The Hidden Treasure at Lizard Lakes
description: How to Begin: After completing Yunobo of Goron City main quest, talk to the village elder. Solution: Go to [Lizard's Burrow](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280779) and claim [Vah Rudania Divine Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280780) Reward: [Vah Rudania Divine Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280780)

title: Supply-Eyeing Fliers
description: How to Begin: Speak to Huck. Solution: Kill the three Aerocudas. Reward: Purple Rupee.

title: The Shrine Explorer
description: How to Begin: Complete all 152 shrines Solution: Open chest located behind Goddess statue. Reward: [Ancient Hero's Aspect](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=289435)

title: A Way to Trade, Washed Away
description: How to Begin: Talk to Garini after completing both [Village Attacked by Pirates](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=290810) and [Lurelin Village Restoration Project](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282395). Solution: Go to [Tenoko Island](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276913). Bring parts necessary to power and steer all 3 boats found there. Take them way back to Lurelin Village. Reward: Star Fragment and Garini's "shop", where you get everything for free.

title: Uma's Garden
description: How to Begin: After completing both [Teach Me a Lesson I](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276905) & [Teach Me a Lesson II](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280079), you can pick this up from Uma tending the nearby garden. Solution: Give Uma a vegetable, then return after a few hours. Reward: - A field filled with the vegetable you gave her; - The ability to repeat the quest as much as you want.

title: Gerudo's Colossal Fossil
description: How to Begin: Complete [Hebra's Colossal Fossil](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278386). Solution: Put the baby fossil back together. Reward: Purple Rupee.

title: A Picture for Foothill Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty painting frame Solution: Take a picture of the massive sculpture of Daruk, at [Goron City](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276852) Reward: One Pony Point and one bottle of Fireproof Elixir

title: The Ancient City Gorondia?
description: How to Begin: Complete [The Ancient City Gorondia!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278325). Dugby will later be found here, still trying to find his way there Solution: Follow Dugby when he rolls away. Clear the rocks on the tracks. Put the mine car on the tracks when the way is clear and speak to Dugby once more at the top and again at the bottom Reward: Large Zonai Charge

title: A Picture for Woodland Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty painting frame Solution: Take a picture of a Goron in some hotsprings. Easiest place is, obviously, the [Goron Hot Springs](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277115) Reward: One Pony Point and some food

title: The Mother Goddess Statue
description: How to Begin: Pray at any Goddess Statue of [Power](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282810), [Wisdom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281636), or [Courage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=282767) to begin this quest. You will return to the [Forgotten Temple](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278171) or if you have it unlocked already, [Mayausiy Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277697). Further in past the shine, you'll see that the Goddess Statue has fallen. Approach the head to examine it. Solution: Complete all three Goddess Statue side quests and return to pray at the Mother Goddess Statue Reward: The White Sword of the Sky

title: A Picture for South Akkala Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty picture frame inside the tent Solution: Take a picture of the Unity Bell in Tarrey Town Reward: One Pony Point and Prime Meat Stew

title: A Picture for New Serenne Stable
description: How to Begin: Interact with picture frame Solution: Take a picture of nearby geoglyph Reward: - Pony Point - Bright Tomato - Mushroom Stew

title: Decorate with Passion
description: How to Begin: Speak with Boraa, sitting by a tent. Solution: Show her any weapon fused with a Ruby. Reward: 1x Electric Keese Wing

title: A Picture for Snowfield Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty frame on the Stable wall. Solution: Go to the Lone Pine Tree on top of Talonto Peak and, looking North-West, take a picture of the Bird with outstretched wings. Reward: 1 Pony Point, Spicy Meat Stew

title: A Picture for Lakeside Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty painting frame. Solution: On a clear day, go to Floria Bridge and take a picture of Floria Falls, just outside the stable. Reward: - 1x Pony Point - 1x Tough Tomato Soup

title: A Picture for East Akkala Stable
description: How to Begin: Examine the empty portrait frame Solution: Take a picture of nearby Octorok Lake (SW of stable) when water levels have risen (during rain) to resemble an Octorok. Reward: - 1 Pony Point - Meal and Rice Bowl

title: Spotting Spot
description: Previous Side Quest: [The Incomplete Stable](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277030) How To Begin: Speak to Lester (requires a certain amount of plot progression) Tame [Spot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=285942) and bring it back to the Mini Stable. Reward: - Spot (Unique Horse) - 50 Rupees - Swift Carrot Note: After completing the quest, speak to Lester again to register the unique horse.

title: Dalia's Game
description: How To Begin: This is a part of The Mysterious Eighth side quest. Speak to Dalia who is located next to the General Store in Gerudo Town, standing next to an orb. Dalia will ask if you want to play a game of hide and seek. Solution: You will have 1 minute and 30 seconds to locate a sand seal plush toy that has been hidden inside the Gerudo Shelter. Reward: Orb that is part of The Mysterious Eighth side quest.

title: Treasure of the Gerudo Desert
description: How to Begin: Speak to Riju a few days after the events of [Riju of the Desert](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279576). Solution: Make your way to the [West Gerudo Underground Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280778) and find [Vah Naboris Divine Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280777). Reward: [Vah Naboris Divine Helm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280777)

title: Unknown Three-Headed Monster
description: How to Begin: Complete all three WANTED monster hunt side quests, then talk to Gralens to start another series of hunts. Solution: Defeat the [Flame Gleeok](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279729) Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Unknown Huge Silhouette
description: How to Begin: Complete all three WANTED monster hunt side quests, then talk to Gralens to start another series of hunts. Solution: Defeat the [Frox](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281951) Reward: Silver Rupee

title: Unknown Sky Giant
description: How to Begin: Complete all three WANTED monster hunt side quests, then talk to Gralens to start another series of hunts. Solution: Defeat the [Flux Construct III](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=279853) Reward: Silver Rupee (100)

title: Misko's Treasure of Awakening II
description: How to Begin: Read the stone tablet on the left of the chest containing [Tunic of Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280855). Solution: Defeat the [Thunder Gleeok](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277325), then Ultrahand the claymore on the statue on the other side of the colosseum. Reward: [Trousers of Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280868)

title: Misko's Treasure: Pirate Manuscript
description: How to Begin: After completing [Misko's Cave of Chests](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280696), trade 100 rupees to Dominiak. Solution: Go to [Cape Cales Cliffbase Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280873) and claim [Tingle's Tights](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280875). Reward: [Tingle's Tights](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280875).

title: Simmerstone Springs
description: How to Begin: Talk to Kima on the bridge on top of the waterfall Solution: Inside of Gorko Tunnel, break the rock wall and enter the hot spring Reward: 100 rupees

title: Ancient Blades Below
description: How to Begin: Speak to one of the Mining Constructs after completing [Guidance From Ages Past](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=287480). Solution: Give him the 50 Zonaite in exchange for an Ancient Blade. Reward: - Ancient Blade - Ability to trade 50 Zonaite for an Ancient Blade

title: Misko's Treasure: Twins Manuscript
description: How to Begin: After completing [Misko's Cave of Chests](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280696), trade 100 rupees to Dominiak. Solution: Head to [Dueling Peaks North Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281727) to grab the pattern from the ceiling. Then, head to [Dueling Peaks South Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280531) and solve the puzzle. Reward: [Tingle's Shirt](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280869)

title: Misko's Treasure: Heroines Manuscript
description: How to Begin: After completing [Misko's Cave of Chests](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280696), trade 100 rupees to Dominiak. Solution: Open the [Statue of the Eighth Heroine Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280871). Reward: [Tingle's Hood](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280872)

title: Misko's Treasure of Awakening III
description: How to Begin: Read the stone tablet beside the chest containing [Trousers of Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280868) Solution: Open the [Thundra Plateau Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280862) Reward: [Mask of Awakening](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=280863)

title: Village Attacked by Pirates
description: How to Begin: Talk to Garini, who is talking to Mubs (she runs the general shop), after completing two [Regional Phenomena](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277708) temples. Solution: Talk to Rozel found at [Lurelin Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278007) Reward: Mighty Salt-Grilled Crab

title: Farosh, Lightning Dragon
description: Location: Flies clockwise between [East Gerudo Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276837) and [Hills of Baumer Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277280) (and completes the circle in The Depths)

title: Light Dragon
description: Location: Circles the entire map high in the sky (passes all the Geoglyphs)

title: Dinraal, Fire Dragon
description: Location: Flies from east to west along the coast north coast between [East Akkala Plains Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277435) and [Drenan Highlands Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276850) (and repeats the cycle in the Depths)

title: Naydra, Frost Dragon
description: Location: Flies in a clockwise circle between [Naydra Snowfield Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=277045) and [East Hill Chasm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=276827) - and completes the cycle in The Depths

title: Red Pillar
description: Location: Just a little southeast of [Miryotanog Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278162). How to Solve: Part of the [Red Pillars Across a Vast Sea](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281150). Locate the nearby turnstile just west of the main tower and use it to elevate the tower so that the light hits the mirror.

title: Red Pillar
description: Location: North of the [Arbitor's Grounds](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=283873) and [Irasak Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=278159). Solution: Break the floor and grab one (or all if desired) of the stone handles. Get it to the roof of the pillar in any manner that works and attach it to the turnstile. Rotate the tower until it points at [the starting light](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=281150).
